# Copilot instructions — nccs-data-bmf

This repo is the BMF producer for the NCCS data system. It writes
parquet/CSV artifacts to `s3://nccsdata/...` that downstream
consumers (the `nccsdata` R package, the dataexplorer API, the
sector-in-brief dashboard, ML pipelines) read directly. Changes
here ripple outward through documented contracts.

## Always-on context

When reviewing a PR or answering a question about this repo, first
read the relevant contracts in the sibling `nccs-contracts` repo:

- `nccs-contracts/ARCHITECTURE.md` — the system overview (one page,
  worth re-reading per session).
- `nccs-contracts/CONTRIBUTING.md` — the plan/execute/reconcile
  loop and the tactical-vs-new-ADR-vs-supersede heuristic.
- `nccs-contracts/contracts/bmf-*.yml` — the four contracts this
  repo produces.
- `nccs-contracts/decisions/` — ADRs that bind producer behavior;
  the ones most relevant to this repo are listed below.

The contracts files are authoritative for what gets published. If a
PR changes producer behavior in a way the contract doesn't reflect,
either the PR description must update the contract YAML (in a
companion PR to `nccs-contracts`) or the change is out of bounds.

## Contracts this repo produces

| Contract | Output path | Producer entrypoint |
|---|---|---|
| `bmf-master` | `s3://nccsdata/master/bmf/` | `R/run_master_pipeline.R` → `R/master_bmf_builder.R` |
| `bmf-master-geocoded` | `s3://nccsdata/geocoding/bmf-master/merged/` | `R/run_master_geocoding.R` → `R/master_geocoding.R` |
| `bmf-lookups` | `s3://nccsdata/lookups/bmf/{vintage}/` + `latest/` | `R/run_publish_lookups.R` → `R/publish_lookups.R` |
| `bmf-legacy` | `s3://nccsdata/processed/bmf-legacy/` | `R/run_legacy_pipeline.R` |

Path-quirk to remember: `s3://nccsdata/master/bmf/state_marts/`
sits under the `bmf-master` prefix but is produced from the
*geocoded* master (`R/master_state_marts.R`). It is contracted
under `bmf-master-geocoded`, not `bmf-master`. By-purpose-of-output,
not by-source-of-input.

## What to flag in PR reviews

Path-filtered to keep Opus cost bounded. The agent should review
PRs that touch contract-sensitive files:

- `R/master_bmf_builder.R`, `R/run_master_pipeline.R` — the
  BMF master pipeline; output schema and S3 path concerns here
  affect `bmf-master` and indirectly every downstream consumer.
- `R/master_geocoding.R`, `R/run_master_geocoding.R`,
  `R/master_state_marts.R` — geocoded master + state marts;
  affects `bmf-master-geocoded`.
- `R/publish_lookups.R`, `R/run_publish_lookups.R` — `bmf-lookups`.
- `R/run_legacy_pipeline.R`, `R/legacy_bmf_adapter.R` — `bmf-legacy`.
- `R/config.R` — S3 path constants; any change here affects the
  contract surface.
- `R/utils/` helpers used by publish paths.

Skip review on: tests for pure transforms, docs that don't reference
contract semantics, `.github/workflows/publish-docs.yml`, lockfiles,
`man/` autogenerated.

When reviewing a flagged PR, check:

1. **Does the change alter what gets written to S3?** Path,
   filename, schema, compression, file count per partition.
   If yes, the matching `nccs-contracts/contracts/bmf-*.yml`
   must be updated in a companion PR. Flag if not.
2. **Schema changes.** A new column, a type change, or a renamed
   column ripples downstream. The contract YAML's `schema.source`
   should reflect it. Drift detection (ARCHITECTURE.md §9 Loop 1)
   depends on this.
3. **Manifest emission.** Per ADR 0014 (standardize manifest
   shape), all producers should emit a `_manifest.json` with the
   standard fields (vintage, built_at UTC, git_sha, inputs,
   files.{name}.{sha256, bytes, row_count, columns}). Currently
   only `bmf-lookups` complies; the master/geocoded/legacy
   producers emit a quality report instead. If a PR touches a
   publish path *without* adding manifest support, that's not
   blocking but worth flagging as a missed opportunity.
4. **Vintage subdirectories.** Per ADR 0013, all producers should
   write to `{key_prefix}/v{YYYY.MM}/` with a `latest/` mirror.
   `bmf-lookups` complies (uses `{YYYY_MM}`, slated to flip to
   `v{YYYY.MM}` at next publish); the others overwrite in place.
   Same flagging principle as manifests.
5. **State-marts path-quirk.** Anyone touching state marts code
   may be tempted to "fix" the path to `geocoding/bmf-master/state_marts/`.
   That would be a breaking change for consumers; the current
   `master/bmf/state_marts/` path is intentional per
   `contracts/bmf-master-geocoded.yml`'s rationale (state marts
   are partitions of an already-geocoded artifact, not a
   geocoding step). Flag any such PR for explicit ADR
   coordination.

## Reference ADRs

- [0001 — S3 as contract surface](https://github.com/UrbanInstitute/nccs-contracts/blob/main/decisions/0001-s3-as-contract-surface.md)
- [0004 — Cadence-aware drift detection](https://github.com/UrbanInstitute/nccs-contracts/blob/main/decisions/0004-cadence-aware-drift-detection.md)
- [0005 — BMF unified superseded by master](https://github.com/UrbanInstitute/nccs-contracts/blob/main/decisions/0005-bmf-unified-superseded-by-master.md)
- [0013 — Versioned producer outputs](https://github.com/UrbanInstitute/nccs-contracts/blob/main/decisions/0013-versioned-producer-outputs.md)
- [0014 — Standardize manifest shape](https://github.com/UrbanInstitute/nccs-contracts/blob/main/decisions/0014-standardize-manifest-shape.md)

ADRs reference each other with `[[adr-slug]]` links inside the
`nccs-contracts` repo; resolve those by reading
`nccs-contracts/decisions/{slug}.md`.

## Reference implementation in this repo

`R/publish_lookups.R` is the reference for both ADR 0013 and ADR
0014. It already does vintage subdirectories, a `latest/` mirror,
sha256-keyed idempotent uploads, and a contract-standard manifest
(modulo the field-name normalization in ADR 0014). When migrating
other producers in this repo to the standardized shape, copy from
there.

## Style and review tone

- Reviews should focus on contract impact, not personal style.
- When pointing at a contract, link the file at its current path
  in `nccs-contracts` so the author can verify.
- If a PR is a behavior change *and* should have a companion
  contract update *and* should have an ADR, say so plainly — but
  one comment, not three.
- If a PR is internal cleanup with no S3-visible effect, default
  to approving with no comment.
